messages:
Zoe (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: leadership needs a 1-line status and any top-1 blocker for API / Console / Optimize so I can send partners a short update. Please keep it tight.

Mara (Product): API: beta preview next Tues; auth v2 and SDK parity remain the main items. Blocker: infra rollout risk for long-lived connections.

Kevin L (Eng): Confirm beta kickoff 2024-05-07. Auth v2 will be rolled with a 10% canary toggle. If we see connection resets in canary, we pause the rollout (thats the main risk).

Jess (Eng PM): Console: new route analytics + simplified onboarding planned for canary in June. Blocker: telemetry v2 events need a consensus schema. Sam, can you finalize docs so we don't ship breaking changes?

Sam (Docs): On it. I'll finish the telemetry schema doc and examples by Thu COB and link the PR here.

Alex (Optimize): Optimize feature: cost-savings suggestions (batching + cache hints) are in internal dogfood. Targeting public beta in mid-July. Blocker: need final opt-out UX for customers who don't want automatic quantization hints.

Ops (Release): Can we confirm canary windows by Friday? Release calendar needs the dates to reserve infra and notify customers.

Riley (SRE): Note from infra: the auth toggle requires a short routing sync which may surface as 1-2 minute blips for some dedicated connections. Were validating a zero-downtime approach but it's not fully proven. That's our risk item.

DevRel Bot: Announcement queued: "beta: API auth v2 + SDK updates" scheduled 2024-05-07 09:00 UTC.

Kevin L (Eng): Config stub for rollout management: 
```
# rollout flags
AUTH_V2_ENABLED=true
CANARY_PERCENT=10
RAMP_DURATION_H=48
```
We'll monitor connection metrics and have an immediate rollback plan.

Mara (Product): Zoe wants the one-liners by EOD. Proposals: 
- API: "Beta preview: new auth v2 and SDK parity; canary next week, monitoring for connection regressions."
- Console: "Canary: updated route analytics and simpler onboarding; telemetry v2 rollout will be coordinated with docs."
- Optimize: "Internal beta: automated batching and cache recommendations to reduce per-token costs; public beta targeted for mid-July."

Zoe (CEO): Good concise drafts. Make the language non-technical for partners, please (keep the high-level benefits).

Jess (Eng PM): Edited for partners: 
- API: "Beta: improved security and SDK alignment to reduce integration friction; limited preview next week."
- Console: "Canary: clearer route-level insights to help teams measure performance; opt-in preview planned."
- Optimize: "Preview: automated suggestions to lower inference costs while preserving quality."

Alex (Optimize): Request: add a checkbox to opt-out of automated quantization/batching suggestions in the preview. Filing ticket now.

DevRel Bot: Ticket created: OPS-8310 "opt-out checkbox for optimize suggestions" assigned to Alex.

Sam (Docs): I'll draft three short partner-friendly bullets and a short FAQ entry for the preview opt-in/out flow by tomorrow.

Ops (Release): Please tag release tickets with FINAL_SIGNOFF by Thu so we can lock windows.

Kevin L (Eng): We'll run an extra canary validation pass tonight focused on long-lived connection stability. Expect thumbs-up or roll-back recommendation by 06:00 UTC.

Riley (SRE): If the extra validation passes, risk drop looks good. If not, we'll delay auth v2 until we have a zero-blip rollout strategy.

Mara (Product): Thanks everyone. I'll package these one-liners + risks and post to comms thread. Zoe, will loop you after Sam posts the partner copy.

Zoe (CEO): Thanks team. If anything changes with the canary validation, ping me here immediately. :thumbsup:
